URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Con.]
Pain in kidneys if urine is restrained.
Sharp pressing in bladder.
Pressure upon bladder as if urine would come out immediately.
Pressure in neck of bladder, with stitches, < when walking, > when sitting.
Great pain in bladder, constant disposition to urinate, only a few drops passing at a time. θ Morning sickness.
Sharp stitches shortly after urinating in region of neck of bladder for many hours.
Shooting stitches in back part of urethra.
Burning, cutting and drawing through urethra while urinating.
Pain in urethra during micturition. θ Vertigo.
Immediately after urinating, burning in urethra, in morning.
Strangury.
Urine cannot be retained.
Constant urging to urinate, with heat on urinating.
Frequent micturition at night. θ Mental derangement.
Passing water does not relieve the desire to do so.
Urine clear as crystal and intermitting in its flow. θ Chronic dysentery.
Intermittent flow of urine with cutting after micturition.
Violent itching, the urine flowing and stopping alternately, at every emission.
Urine : clear as crystal ; thick ; white, turbid, with grey or white sediment ; mucous ; bloody.
Urine turbid, after standing, dirty grey, with a yellowish tint. θ Diphtheria after scarlatina.
Urine scant, brown or full of sediment, containing bile, with burning on urination. θ Enlarged liver.
Urine feels hot. θ Uterine disorder.
Parenchymatous nephritis after scarlet fever.
Gravel.
Diabetes : accompanied by great pain ; with swelling and suppuration of left parotid gland.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Con.]
Sexual desire without erection.
With weakness of sexual organs, much sexual erethism, amatory thoughts, even emissions provoked by mere presence of women.
Great sexual desire with partial or complete incapacity ; emissions on slightest provocation, melancholy.
Emissions without dreams.
Nightly emissions and spermatorrhœa ; urine flowing and stopping again at each passage of water.
Painful emission of semen.
Pollutions, with subsequent excitement of sexual desire.
Excessive pollutions, particularly of young people.
Excessive pollutions, with no history of previous excesses.
Bad effects from suppressed sexual desire, or from excessive indulgence.
Sexual weakness. θ Anemia of brain. θ Mental derangement.
Insufficient erection, lasting only a short time ; feeble embrace ; weakness after an embrace.
Impotence and want of erections.
Swelling and induration of testicles, particularly after contusion.
Cutting pain through scrotum to root of penis ; pressing and tearing pains in testes.
Chronic prostatic disease, the gland swollen, hard as stone, firmly fixed, and much biting-itching, or biting like flea-bites, a weight like a stone in perineum.
Discharge of prostatic fluid on every change of emotion, without voluptuous thoughts, or while expelling feces ; with itching of prepuce.
Very severe pains, coming on at night, waking from sleep ; orchitis from contusion swelling of testes ; firm hematocele, like a stone.
Recent cases of gonorrhœa with orchitis and severe nocturnal pains.
Indurated chancre of long standing.
Rheumatism after suppressed gonorrhœa.
Syphilitic sarcocele.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Con.]
Ill effects of suppressed sexual instinct, or non-gratification of sexual appetite.
Induration and enlargement of ovaries or womb, with lancinating pains.
Indurations, especially of a scrofulous nature or from injuries.
Prolapsus uteri complicated with induration, ulceration and profuse leucorrhœa.
Uterus prolapsed and anteverted ; bearing down as though womb would be forced from vulva ; < when standing and walking, before and during menses ; dysmenorrhœa.
Induration of cervix ; sharp pains in part ; prolapsus uteri ; acrid leucorrhœa ; swelling of breasts ; stitches in breasts mostly at night.
Weight and lancinating pains in womb and ovaries, extending through whole lower part of abdomen, hips and back ; during stool a foreign body protrudes from vulva ; copious and frequent uterine hemorrhages ; leucorrhœa reddish, extremely fetid. θ Uterine polypi.
Uterine spasms ; rigidity of os uteri.
A grinding pain is felt above pudendum ; the abdomen becomes inflated, the chest is affected and stitches are felt in left side.
Uterine spasm during too early and scanty catamenia, followed by leucorrhœa, with nightly pains, hysterical paroxysms.
Labor-like contractions.
Labor-like colic from both sides of abdomen.
Stitching pains in womb, with such symptoms as accompany pregnancy ; nausea and vomiting, craving sour or salt things ; pain and swelling of mamma during menses, dejection of spirits, etc.
Pinching and griping in uterus.
Stitches in uterus extend to right side of chest.
Burning, stinging, darting pains in neck of uterus, with indurations and scirrhosities.
Burning, sore, aching sensation in region of uterus.
Before menstruation : anxious dreams ; heat without thirst ; general bruised feeling, with inclination to weep ; restlessness and anxious apprehensiveness ; pains in breasts, with soreness and swelling ; stitches in liver ; distension.
Great soreness of breasts precedes menstruation ; < by least jar or walking.
Amenorrhœa : genitals very sensitive ; complicated with ovarian or uterine disease and chlorosis ; with venous abdominal hyperemia.
Brownish blood instead of menses.
During menstruation : great fears when alone, but dread of strangers or company ; labor-like abdominal pains, extending into thigh ; stitches in chest ; headache ; eruption ; stinging pains in neck of uterus.
At every menstrual effort the breasts enlarge, become sore and painful.
Breasts relaxed, except at menstrual period.
Pressure from above downward, and drawing in legs during menses.
Menses too weak.
Menses irregular, three months passing sometimes without appearance of menses, and then they are scanty. θ Inflammation of eyes.
Dysmenorrhœa, with shooting pains in left chest, or sharp pains about heart.
Dysmenorrhœa : pains in hypogastric region and down legs ; sharp pain in back ; chills commencing in breasts ; vertigo in bed, everything turning round ; menses too soon, too profuse, natural in color ; has weak spells.
Catamenia too late, scanty, and of short duration.
Menses : suppressed ; feeble, too late and scanty, of short duration.
Delayed and scanty menstruation, with symptoms pointing to congestions in other organs, and especially when mamma are lax and shrunken.
Menses scant, clotted, accompanied by rash over whole body of small red pimples, which burn severely when scratched, and disappear with cessation of menstruation.
Menses stopped by taking cold ; putting hands in cold water ; sour rising of food ; urine intermits ; nosebleed.
Every four weeks, great sensitiveness of labia majora and minora ; constant dry heat of body without thirst ; anxious dreams ; heaviness in all the limbs ; tearfulness ; restlessness ; anxious concern about trifles ; stitches in hepatic region, often lasting several days and greatly prostrating her, with entire absence of menstruation.
Violent itching of pudenda and vagina, especially after menses.
Leucorrhœa ten days after menses, stopping suddenly and soon flowing again, lasting several days, with much pain in bowels before discharge.
Acrid and burning leucorrhœa, white or yellow, preceded by griping and pinching pains in abdomen and lameness of small of back, followed by weariness.
Leucorrhœa : profuse ; bloody, mucous ; excoriating ; thick, milky, with contractive, labor-like colic, coming from both sides ; of white, acrid mucus, causing burning or smarting sensation.
Bearing down and stitches in vagina.
Severe itching deep in vagina.
Indurations of vulva from injuries.
Severe stitches in vulva.
Peculiar digging in vulva, a crampy pain.
Violent itching of vulva, followed by pressing down of uterus, especially after menses.
Sensitive pudenda and mammary glands.
Cutting pain between labia on micturition.
Sero-purulent eruption on mons veneris.
Large pimple on mons veneris, painful to touch.
Climaxis, with flushes of heat and sweat.
Shriveling of mamma, without sexual desire.
Fibroid tumors of uterus.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Con.]
Unready conception due to passive congestion.
Terrible nausea and vomiting in women suffering from scirrhosities during pregnancy.
Terrible nausea and vomiting during pregnancy.
Wakes in morning sick at stomach, vomiting several times from 5 o'clock till breakfast ; the substance vomited is white and frothy, followed by something yellow, like bile, < from raising head ; vomits several times during day ; three months pregnant.
Aching pain in abdomen during pregnancy ; is disturbed between 12 and 3 o'clock at night by having to get up to urinate ; has no affection for anybody.
Cough during pregnancy, < at night.
Obstinate cramps in stomach during pregnancy ; sensation of constriction, or of a heavy weight pressing upon stomach ; pains are constant but remittent in character, gradually growing so severe as to become unbearable ; constant dry, spasmodic cough which aggravates the cramps ; cough < from speaking, walking, or mental emotions.
Excessive heartburn at night while going to bed, in pregnant women.
Rigidity of os uteri during labor.
During parturition, complete sleeplessness and exhaustion ; can hardly speak a few words ; extreme sensibility to light, shunning the light to such a degree that smallest ray of sunlight causes great anguish.
After-pains excited by child nursing, pains extending from left to right.
In first week after delivery, could not move head to turn over in bed on account of great vertigo.
Constant discharge of thin, watery milk from breasts for nine months after child has been weaned.
Induration of right mammary gland during lactation ; burning pain. θ Mastitis.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Con.]
Lisping voice.
Larynx sensitive to touch. θ Cough.
Dry spot in larynx, where there are crawling and almost constant irritation to cough.
Constant tickling and itching, dry, teasing cough.
Scraping in larynx, with irritation to cough, and dry cough in evening.
Hoarseness : cough and expectoration ; after leucorrhœa.
Blennorrhœa bronchialis.
Chronic cough from enlargement of bronchial glands, with irritation of tracheal and laryngeal lining.
Nervous bronchial asthma, paroxysmal, coming on in wet weather.
